en: The postcard features a colored illustration of a church with a tall bell tower and people walking in front of it. To the right, there is a collage of religious imagery, including the Madonna and Child, crucifixion scene, and other religious figures. Decorative floral elements are present on the border. The word 'TERSATTO' is prominent, and Latin text appears at the top. Handwritten text is visible at the bottom.
